explanation: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Đồng Đăng (1885)" (revision 1370603011) says: "Three weeks later the Chinese attacked the Đồng Đăng garrison, precipitating a series of events that led to the French defeat at the Battle of Bang Bo (24 March 1885)." The edge reads that sentence as: Battle of Đồng Đăng (1885) caused Battle of Bang Bo (Zhennan Pass), and nothing more.
